sentences.text: Harald V -LRB- -LSB- ˈhɑrːɑɫ -RSB- ; born 21 February 1937 -RRB- is the King of Norway , having ascended the throne following the death of his father on 17 January 1991 .	King of Norway	King of Norway	Norway	Norway

Harald was the third child and only son of Olav V of Norway and Princess Märtha of Sweden .	Olav V	Olav V of Norway	Olav V of Norway	Olav V of Norway	Princess Märtha of Sweden	Princess Märtha of Sweden	Norway	Norway	Märtha	Princess Märtha Louise of Norway
He was second in the line of succession at the time of his birth , behind his father .	line of succession	Line of succession to the Norwegian throne
In 1940 , as a result of the German occupation during World War II , the royal family went into exile .	German occupation	German occupation of Norway
Harald spent part of his childhood in Sweden and the United States .

He returned to Norway in 1945 , and subsequently studied for periods at the University of Oslo , the Norwegian Military Academy , and Balliol College , Oxford .	Norway	Norway	University of Oslo	University of Oslo	Norwegian Military Academy	Norwegian Military Academy
In 1957 , following the death of his grandfather , Haakon VII , Harald became crown prince .	Haakon VII	Haakon VII of Norway	Haakon	Haakon, Crown Prince of Norway

A keen sportsman , he represented Norway in sailing at the 1964 , 1968 , and 1972 Olympic Games , and later became patron of World Sailing .
